'''Fa'ann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].

==Behind the scenes==
Fa'ann first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Centurion PvP Gear vendor for the Sith Warrior class. He was later removed during a restructuring of the game's PvP gear system, but was later reused as a vendor for the [[2014]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''. He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
